description: LEGACY wallet flow — new integrations should use create_account and launch_campaign (API key + prepaid balance, no wallet). (launch_campaign is its equivalent for the key flow.) Creates a new anonymous audio feedback campaign. Two modes: (a) INCENTIVIZED — participants earn USDC rewards; you must fund an escrow address     returned in the response, then call verify_campaign_funding. Participants have 30 days after     the campaign ends to claim; anything unclaimed then goes back to the wallet you signed in with. (b) NO_REWARD — survey only, no crypto rewards; you pay a flat Stripe activation fee     (returned in activationRequired), then call verify_campaign_activation. The accessToken is single-use and is consumed on success. Privacy threshold: minPercent enforces the minimum response rate before results are unlocked (minimum 50%). Campaign expiry: 1–42 days (default 7).

cohortEmails.description: Email addresses of participants (minimum 2 for privacy)

description.description: Short description of the campaign purpose

digitalGiftText.description: Optional digital gift description shown to NO_REWARD participants (e.g. a discount code)

incentiveCents.description: Reward per participant in cents (e.g. 500 = $5.00). Required for INCENTIVIZED.

minPercent.description: Minimum response rate (%) required to unlock results. Defaults to 50.

questions.description: List of audio questions for participants to answer

rewardMint.description: SPL token mint address for rewards. Defaults to USDC if omitted.

rewardMode.description: INCENTIVIZED: crypto rewards per response. NO_REWARD: survey only, flat activation fee.

name: create_campaign
